verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an official Mail MCP server that connects inbox/calendar to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants, enabling summarizing, drafting, sending, and scheduling via prompts, with explicit send approval as a safety control; this is corroborated by a dedicated feature page and blog announcement plus a probe confirming the MCP page exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on/community verification of the MCP server's real-world reliability and setup process beyond first-party docs.
